C001.title: Querent sits in the authority seat of a documents-and-visibility undertaking
C001.guidance: The chart seats the querent (day stem 壬) with 值符, the education star 天辅 and the visibility gate 景门 in Palace 6: this assignment is read as fundamentally a credibility-and-visibility document task, and the querent is well-placed to author it. Tradition-conditional reading, not a factual prediction.
C001.claim_rank_reason: bounded by I002's three restrictive markers in the same palace

C002.title: The authority seat is force-penalised: no blunt pushing
C002.guidance: Palace 6's explicit 门迫宫 + 门入墓 + 伏干格 read as: effort that pushes against the environment backfires and blind self-initiated attack rebounds. In assignment terms: the deck should persuade through structure and usefulness, not through loud claims or over-optimisation tricks.
C002.claim_rank_reason: all three markers explicit; two compute-confirmed

C003.title: The matter itself (hour stem 庚) favours indirect, paced, iterative execution
C003.guidance: 庚 under 飞干格 with 太白退位 ('detours, change of place') but 门生宫 ('effort invested returns value'): the campaign/strategy should be built in passes — pilot, reposition, iterate — not launched as one frontal push. Direct aggressive action is the explicitly penalised path.

C004.title: Querent and matter interlock: SEO and PR must be sequenced as one system
C004.guidance: The 壬/庚 seat-exchange (R010, R018) reads as querent and task mutually overlaying: the two halves of the assignment (search discoverability, earned media) are interlocked and drain each other if forced in parallel. Integration slide (Q7) should show one loop with sequenced handoffs, not two simultaneous blasts.

C005.title: Palace 9 is the strategic engine: cooperative, visible, life-gating campaign core
C005.guidance: The densest auspicious cluster (生门+宫生门, 六合, 帝旺/长生, 三奇升殿, 奇游禄位, 日月并行 'favours cooperative affairs', 青龙合会 'partnership benefactors') sits in Li-9, the south/visibility sector. The chart's strongest recommendation is a co-creation/partnership-shaped campaign built for public visibility — the Big PR Idea (slide 7) should be participation-led, not a solo brand announcement.
C005.claim_rank_reason: eight explicit auspicious formations in one palace; highest support tally in chart

C006.title: The execution channel is obstruction-gated: stealth build, long-tail first, no noisy confrontation
C006.guidance: Zhi_shi 杜门 in P7 with 华盖地户 ('quiet planning benefits; open-front affairs unfavourable') and 凶蛇入狱 ('do not act rashly'): pre-launch should be a quiet, gated build — long-tail/niche keyword targeting, seeded community work, embargoed pitching — with the loud moment reserved for the P9 engine, not the P7 channel.

C007.title: Discovery door is open but deception-guarded: evidence-based authenticity is enforced
C007.guidance: 开门 with 癸 at 长生 is a genuine opening for discovery (Q1-Q3), but 玄武 + 地刑玄武 ('deception exposed') + hidden 太白冲刑 ('force against force reaps harm') read as: invented data, copied campaigns or aggressive head-to-head positioning get exposed and backfire. This independently mirrors the assignment's DON'T list; the chart supports an evidence-led, original positioning.

C008.title: Outreach to editors/experts with documents is favoured, via high-reach but slow channels
C008.guidance: 九天 ('high, far-reaching') with 奇仪顺遂 '利文书谒贵' (benefits documents and calling on notables) and 星随月转 ('attaching to a patron advances') supports the media-pitch slide: lead with a document/research asset and attach to established voices. 死门 + 门迫宫 temper it: expect slow, cold-start responses; pitch patiently and revive dormant contacts rather than expecting instant pickup.
C008.claim_rank_reason: auspicious document formations bounded by 死门/门迫宫 in the same palace

C009.title: Data/report-shaped PR asset is auspicious in substance but distribution-gated
C009.guidance: P8's 青龙耀明 + 犬遇青龙 ('benefactors give money and effort') + 宫生门 favour a substantial data/report asset, but 丁奇入墓 ('messages do not get through'), 门入墓 and 惊门 under slow 九地 say its distribution is currently gated: publish through grounded, low-posture channels, pre-verify that information routes (site, press kit, indexation) are unblocked, and avoid controversy-bait (惊门).
C009.claim_rank_reason: strong auspicious core bounded by three explicit blockage markers

C010.title: Documents pile up at the centre: consolidate, deduplicate, unify the message
C010.guidance: 伏吟天庭 ('official documents duplicate; unfavourable'), lodged into P8 (R034), reads as a consolidation directive: deduplicate the keyword list, avoid overlapping page targets in the mapping, and keep one unified message hierarchy across SEO and PR deliverables. Proliferation of near-identical content/assets is the chart-marked failure mode.

C011.title: Audience-insight work is favoured in private; competitive aggression and loose partnerships are penalised
C011.guidance: P2 (Kun — the mass/public sector) holds 太阴 (private/hidden) with 青龙耀明 (bright documents/wealth prospects): consumer-insight and community listening done privately is favoured. 伤门 + 门迫宫 + 门入墓 penalise harm-shaped competitive attacks (dis comparative campaigns), and hidden 螣蛇夭矫 ('partnerships dissolve, quarrels') says creator/partner agreements must be explicit and formalised.
C011.claim_rank_reason: auspicious 太阴/青龙耀明 core bounded by 伤门 and tomb/force markers

C012.title: Timing (tradition-conditional): querent's document work matures through 戌-亥; visibility peaks at 午; openings sprout at 卯
C012.guidance: Phase rows place 壬 at 冠带/临官 through 戌-亥 (the cast hour is 庚戌 — the querent is inside the maturing window now), 癸 长生 at 卯 (openings/initiation), 丙/戊 帝旺 at 午 (peak visibility, Li-9). As tradition-conditional guidance: do the document/authority work now, seed openings in an 卯 window, and schedule the campaign's peak-visibility moment toward a 午 window. This is symbolic timing, not a factual prediction.

C013.title: Measurement framework maps symbolically onto the chart's gates and deities
C013.guidance: Assumption-indexed symbolic mapping for the KPI slide: 景门→impressions/visibility, 开门→organic discovery/sessions, 生门→conversions/growth, 六合→mentions/shares/partnerships, 杜门→gated paths (indexation/coverage gaps), 惊门→sentiment spikes, 天芮→defect/error monitoring. Use as a framing device for the six KPIs; the numbers themselves must come from real tools, never invented (UNK-002).
